clue.text: Mediums for destroying ships — including, initially, yachts, canoes and coracles

indicators.note: destroying the word ships breaks it up so its letters can be rebuilt with the extra ones
initially asks for the opening letter of each of the three boat names

explanation.surface: A list of small craft being wrecked, from yachts down to coracles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'including' says the first letters Y, C, C join SHIPS; 'destroying' then rearranges all eight letters together.
explanation.definitionFit: Spiritualist mediums claim second sight, so they are clairvoyants of that kind.

clue.text: Sticker to follow new titles

indicators.note: to follow places the little word after the rearranged letters
new signals a fresh arrangement of the letters of titles

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Something to stick on that comes after newly printed titles, like a label.
explanation.walkthrough: A sticker here is something that sticks people, a slim dagger, not an adhesive label.
explanation.definitionFit: A stiletto is a slim dagger, something used to stab or stick a person.

clue.text: First woo with marital potential on trial

indicators.note: First tells us the synonym for woo opens the answer

parts.note: to woo is to court a sweetheart

indicators.note: potential suggests the letters of marital could become something else

explanation.surface: A suitor's wooing with a view to marriage, as if the romance were on probation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'potential' is a loose anagram signal: the letters of marital have the potential to become a new word.
explanation.definitionFit: A court martial is a military tribunal, a hearing held under service law.

clue.text: Pixie about to go round the bend contaminated

indicators.note: to go round the bend places the word for about beyond the bend letter

parts.note: a pixie is a mischievous imp
a U-bend gives U for a bend
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A mischievous sprite going mad and becoming tainted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go round the bend' reads like going mad; here the bend is U, and RE (about) goes past it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something impure is tainted or polluted by foreign matter.

clue.text: Digging instrument used by Murphy

definitions.meaning: a narrow spade for digging out weeds
Murphy is Irish-flavoured slang for a potato

explanation.definitionFit: A spud is both a small weeding spade and an everyday word for a potato, which Murphy is slang for.

clue.text: Piece of cake to shove on

parts.note: to shove is to push
on in the sense of on top of, over

explanation.surface: Something as easy as cake that you can simply shove along.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of cake is an easy task, and so is a walkover of that sort.

clue.text: Lose out to blackthorn

indicators.note: out suggests the letters of lose are disordered

explanation.surface: Losing out to a thorny hedge.
explanation.definitionFit: The blackthorn is the shrub whose small bitter fruit is used to flavour gin; the fruit's name is used for the bush too.

clue.text: Shrub garden turns up first class

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: turns up in a down clue means the following letters are read upwards

parts.note: A1 means first class, written AI

explanation.surface: A shrub in the garden turning out to be top quality.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns up' sends AI (A1, first class) upwards in this down light to give IA.
explanation.definitionFit: A gardenia is an evergreen bush with fragrant white flowers.

clue.text: Cut back all for strong silk fabric

parts.note: to prune is to cut back a plant

indicators.note: back tells us the word all is written in reverse

explanation.surface: Trimming everything back to make a tough silky cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cut back' looks like one phrase meaning prune; 'back' instead reverses ALL to LLA.
explanation.definitionFit: Prunella is a strong worsted or silk cloth once used for gowns and shoe uppers.

clue.text: Instead just rest at Ugandan capital

parts.note: to just rest is simply to lie down

indicators.note: capital means the opening letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: Taking a break in Uganda's capital rather than somewhere else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like Kampala; it means the first letter, U.
explanation.definitionFit: In lieu of means in place of, so the word carries the sense of substitution.

clue.text: Bet on hundred broken crackers

indicators.note: broken means the letters of the three words are smashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: A wager on a hundred going wrong, with biscuits in the picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Crackers is slang for mad, as is this idiom for losing one's wits.

clue.text: The veins of kinships

parts.note: kin is blood and ships are vessels, so the tubes that carry blood are read as family ties plus boats

explanation.definitionFit: Veins and arteries are the tubes carrying the body's circulation.

clue.text: A wild headlong rush on funny looking speed mat

indicators.note: funny looking says the letters of speed mat appear in an odd order

explanation.surface: Something odd about a mat designed for speed, as crowds charge across it.
explanation.definitionFit: A stampede is a sudden panicked charge of a herd or crowd.

clue.text: Mnemosyne had time to have her

definitions.text: Mnemosyne had time to have her

parts.note: an era is a period of time
taken as written

explanation.surface: The goddess of memory took time to give birth to a daughter.
explanation.walkthrough: In Greek myth Mnemosyne bore Zeus nine Muses; this one is the Muse of love poetry.
explanation.definitionFit: Mnemosyne, goddess of memory, was mother of the nine Muses, of whom this is the lyric-poetry one.

clue.text: Six nil up with nothing to fiddle

indicators.note: with means the round letter is set among the others

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals

indicators.note: up in an across clue still means the word nil is turned around

parts.note: taken as written
O is nothing, the zero

explanation.surface: A six-nil scoreline with nobody else scoring, apparently fixed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' acts as the container signal here, setting the zero inside the run made from six and nil turned up.
explanation.definitionFit: Fiddle is the everyday name for the violin.

clue.text: Saw sound of upward flight

indicators.note: sound tells us to say the word saw out loud, rhyming with roar

parts.note: the word saw as spoken, in non-rhotic British speech

explanation.surface: Watching the noise of something taking off.
explanation.walkthrough: In British pronunciation the past tense of see sounds the same as the word for climbing high.
explanation.definitionFit: To soar is to rise high on the air, so the word names rising flight.

clue.text: Island hat seen in Mexico

definitions.meaning: A small Caribbean island belonging to Anguilla

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a tiny islet in the Leeward Islands and the wide-brimmed Mexican headwear.

clue.text: A dash of talent

definitions.meaning: dash in the sense of style and panache

explanation.definitionFit: Flair means both stylish panache and an instinctive gift for something.

clue.text: Pay relief for tootsies to relax

parts.note: to foot the bill is to pay it
to rest is to relax

explanation.surface: Paying for something to soothe tired feet.
explanation.definitionFit: Tootsies is a childish word for feet, and a support to put them up on eases them.

clue.text: Information of American lawyer reservist

parts.note: a DA is a District Attorney, a US prosecutor
TA is the Territorial Army, the British Army's volunteer reserve

explanation.surface: Facts gathered by a US attorney who is also in the reserves.
explanation.walkthrough: The TA (Territorial Army) is Britain's part-time volunteer military reserve, so a reservist is TA.
explanation.definitionFit: Data are facts and figures, the raw material of knowledge.

clue.text: Old plate for the man who is a hearty eater

definitions.meaning: a wooden platter in former times

definitions.text: the man who is a hearty eater
definitions.meaning: a trencherman is someone with a big appetite

explanation.definitionFit: A trencher was a medieval wooden dish, and the word also stands for a trencherman, a big eater.

clue.text: Told to see one firm physician

parts.note: see spoken out loud is sea, and the sea in crosswords is often the Med
I is the Roman numeral one
Co is the abbreviation for company

explanation.surface: A patient instructed to visit a doctor's practice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Told' means said out loud: see sounds like sea, and the Mediterranean is the Med.
explanation.definitionFit: Medico is informal for a doctor or medical student.

clue.text: Vigilant round sty I'd say

parts.note: O is round in shape
a pigsty is a pen

indicators.note: say tells us to speak the contraction out loud

parts.note: the contraction for I would, spoken

explanation.surface: Someone watchful going around a pigsty, offering a view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I'd say' reads like an opinion; spoken, I'd sounds like EYED.
explanation.definitionFit: Watchful and alert people keep their eyes wide, fully observant.

clue.text: At best a tedious piece of land

indicators.note: piece of means a section is taken from the run of letters

explanation.surface: A dull stretch of ground at best.
explanation.definitionFit: An estate is a large area of land with a house on it.

clue.text: Personal transport to keep one on one's feet

definitions.text: Personal transport to keep one on one's feet

parts.words: Personal transport to keep one on one's feet
parts.note: looks like help for staying upright, but it is a wheeled vehicle strapped under each shoe

explanation.definitionFit: Wheeled boots carry one person each, and they are literally worn on the feet.

clue.text: Hot stuff in the bed of lavatera

indicators.note: in the bed of says the letters lie at the base of the word lavatera, like a plant in a flower bed

explanation.surface: Something hot hiding in a mallow bed in the garden.
explanation.walkthrough: Lavatera is a garden mallow; a lava bed is also a volcanic plain.
explanation.definitionFit: Molten volcanic rock is extremely hot material.

clue.text: Student in the gear belonging to the Scotsman

indicators.note: in puts the learner letter inside the word for gear

parts.note: kit means gear or equipment
L is a learner, the student driver's plate

explanation.surface: A student dressed in the outfit of a Scot.
explanation.definitionFit: The pleated tartan skirt is the item of dress that Highland men wear.

clue.text: A sound return without an investment?

definitions.text: A sound return without an investment?

parts.words: A sound return without an investment?
parts.note: reads as a safe financial profit, but means a noise bouncing back with nothing put in

explanation.definitionFit: An echo is reflected noise, coming back without anything being spent.

clue.text: Initially right several wrong face setback

indicators.note: Initially takes just the opening letter of right
wrong face suggests the word several is given a different appearance

explanation.surface: Several people losing face after a setback, starting off right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrong face' is read as giving several a wrong appearance, i.e. rearranging its letters; 'face' is not part of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A reversal is a change of fortune for the worse.

clue.text: Try a sure new method in the exchequer

indicators.note: new method says the letters of try a sure are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A government finance department trying a novel approach.
explanation.definitionFit: The exchequer is the government department in charge of public money.
